text.p: These are the leading stories in the Algerian press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Many countries envy Algeria's approach to building a multi-party democracy. Even sceptical foreign analysts have changed their minds and show optimism about the Algerian political experience.
- U.S. leading political figure William Quandt says Algeria's success in holding a fair and free elections on June 5 will put the country on a path of stability.
- Air Algerie to resume flights to Paris airport on April 25, increasing flights gradually.
- Prime Minister Ahmed Ouyahia, other government ministers and former ministers lead National Democratic Rally candidate lists for the parliamentary elections.
- Army calls on rebels to give themselves up to the authorities.
